description.raw: '''Innate - The Ball:''' '''Orianna''' is accompanied by ''The Ball'', which she commands with her [[File:Champion ability.svg|20px|link=Champion ability|An icon representing the keyword Champion ability]] [[:Champion ability|abilities]]. ''The Ball'' incurs a [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] 0.01-second global cooldown on all of her abilities when she casts any ability. Additionally, ''The Ball'' attaches to '''Orianna''' if she is near it, and snaps back to her if she moves too far away from it, which incurs a [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] 0.75-second cooldown on ''[[File:Orianna Command- Shockwave.png|20xpx|border|link=Orianna#Command: Shockwave|An icon for Orianna's ability Command: Shockwave]] [[Orianna#Command: Shockwave|Command: Shockwave]]''.
description.text: Innate - The Ball: Orianna is accompanied by The Ball, which she commands with her abilities. The Ball incurs a  0.01-second global cooldown on all of her abilities when she casts any ability. Additionally, The Ball attaches to Orianna if she is near it, and snaps back to her if she moves too far away from it, which incurs a  0.75-second cooldown on Command: Shockwave.

description2.raw:
'''Innate:''' '''Orianna's''' [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] generate a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Clockwork Winding'' for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 2 times. All stacks are lost when attacking a new enemy.

'''Clockwork Winding:''' '''Orianna's''' [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] are empowered to deal 10 – 54.71 (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] (+ 15% AP) '''bonus''' magic damage [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]], increased by「 15% 」「 1.5 – 8.21 (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] (+ 2.25% AP) 」per stack, up to 13 – 71.12 (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] (+ 19.5% AP) '''total bonus''' magic damage.
description2.text:
Innate: Orianna's basic attacks generate a stack of Clockwork Winding for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 2 times. All stacks are lost when attacking a new enemy.
Clockwork Winding: Orianna's basic attacks are empowered to deal 10 – 54.71 (based on level)Category:Debug (+ 15% AP) bonus magic damage on-hit, increased by「 15% 」「 1.5 – 8.21 (based on level)Category:Debug (+ 2.25% AP) 」per stack, up to 13 – 71.12 (based on level)Category:Debug (+ 19.5% AP) total bonus magic damage.

description3.raw: ''See [[Orianna#Pets|Pets]] for more details about The Ball.''
description3.text: See Pets for more details about The Ball.

notes.raw: * ''Clockwork Winding's'' stack count can be seen in '''Orianna's''' buff bar. * ''The Ball'' will not incur its global cooldown from a ''[[File:Orianna Command- Protect.png|20xpx|border|link=Orianna#Command: Protect|An icon for Orianna's ability Command: Protect]] [[Orianna#Command: Protect|Command: Protect]]'' cast that is used on a target already attached to it. * The attacks do not deal the '''bonus''' damage against [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]]. * [[File:Runaan's Hurricane item.png|20xpx|border|link=Runaan's Hurricane|An icon for the item Runaan's Hurricane]] [[Runaan's Hurricane|Runaan's Hurricane's]] extra bolts will cause ''Clockwork Winding'' to reset its stacks, as she hits targets other than her latest one [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]].(unexpected)
notes.text:
Clockwork Winding's stack count can be seen in Orianna's buff bar.
The Ball will not incur its global cooldown from a Command: Protect cast that is used on a target already attached to it.
The attacks do not deal the bonus damage against structures.
Runaan's Hurricane's extra bolts will cause Clockwork Winding to reset its stacks, as she hits targets other than her latest one on-hit.(unexpected)
